chunks: Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Imran ad-Daqqaq - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Muhammad ibn Abi al-Kufi quoted on the authority of Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Salih al-Razi, on the authority of Hamdan ad-Diwanii that Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) said:
The friend of any individual is his mind and his enemy is his ignorance.
ai.seo_question: What is the friend and enemy of a person according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) defines the internal companions of a person as their intellect (mind) and their internal adversary as their ignorance. This teaching highlights the ethical and cognitive dimensions of self-awareness, positioning reason as the ally that guides one and ignorance as the foe that misleads. In Shia scholarship, this hadith is often cited to emphasize the necessity of cultivating 'aql (intellect) as the primary criterion for distinguishing truth from falsehood, aligning with the concept of the 'innate intellect' (al-aql al-fitri) that serves as the internal proof (hujjah) for every individual.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 26-15 Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Imran ad-Daqqaq - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Muhammad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Kufi quoted on the authority of Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Salih al-Razi, on the authority of Hamdan ad-Diawni that Al-Ridha (s) said, “
The friend of any individual is his mind and his enemy is his ignorance.”
